verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents an Exports API with date-ranged export types covering customers, customer screening, screening and monitoring cases, and transaction-monitoring cases and alerts, plus external-identifier customer lookup and a per-case audit trail. However, the evidence never shows that exports include decision fields or stable record identifiers, and download URLs expire after 5 seconds. missing for 10: documented export schema showing stable IDs on each record, explicit decision data in exports, alert export for screening (not only transaction monitoring), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export customer, alert, case and decision data with stable identifiers for reconciliation
